newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Large parcel of QUF traded at A$2.50.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Large parcel of QUF traded at A$2.50.

text.p: Dairy food group QUF Industries Ltd saw a parcel of about 5.4 percent of its issued capital put through the market in early trade on Monday.
Dealers said the parcel of 4.3 million shares was dealt at a price of A$2.50 by Brisbane-based broker, Wilson HTM.
A spokesman from Wilson HTM said he could not comment on the deal other than to say that institutions were involved.

QUF has nearly 9,000 shareholders and about 50 percent of its stock is held by institutions. The company reported a 23.3 percent fall in its net profit to A$11.5 million for the year to June 30, 1996. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
